title: New skill: e2e-test — run and maintain the browser end-to-end test suite
description: frontend-e2e-tests adds a real, committed browser e2e test suite. Create a `.claude/skills/e2e-test` (name TBD, record the actual choice) skill that runs and maintains it — analogous to static-verify (lint/type-check) and check-coverage (unit/component coverage gate) — giving agents and humans a documented, repeatable way to run the full e2e suite and interpret failures. This is distinct from task-qa-reviewer's existing ad hoc single-task Playwright browser walkthrough: that's an interactive, one-off manual check during task verification, while this skill runs the persisted, versioned e2e spec files frontend-e2e-tests adds.

checklist.step: Design the skill's scope (run the full e2e suite, report pass/fail per spec with enough detail to debug a failure) and how it differs from/relates to task-qa-reviewer's existing browser-walkthrough step; record as a decisions entry.
Create .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md implementing the chosen approach, following existing skill file conventions (see static-verify, check-coverage).
Register the new skill in CLAUDE.md's Skills list.

Decide whether pr-reviewer and/or task-qa-reviewer should be updated to invoke this skill for UI-facing PRs/tasks (similar to how static-verify was wired into pr-reviewer.md/task-qa-reviewer.md), and make that change if so; record the decision either way as a decisions entry.
Run the skill once for real against the current e2e suite as a smoke test and report what it found.
